description: A gruvbox theme for coding: flat surfaces, a monospace UI and a composer styled as a terminal prompt, with settings for the accent colour, interface and code fonts, text size, corners and the prompt glyph. Dark mode is gruvbox soft (#32302f); light mode keeps gruvbox's ink on a neutral paper base instead of the yellow #fbf1c7, with accents darkened to stay readable. Ships gruvbox syntax colours for diffs and a gruvbox terminal palette for each mode. Pick Gruve under Settings → Appearance.
